text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for training, but Aston Machan
hasn't
shown up. Feeling concerned, I go
looking for
her.

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this girl's face is, like, everywhere
lately!
I know, right?! I've literally got
her name
memorized!
This lipstick she's
promoting is real cute too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Collaborations seem like a great way to
gain
exposure. If I want to build my
fanbase, I should
probably get Machan
dolls involved in some kind
of co—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello, Agent Trainer. Machan the
Spy is
currently in the field.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gathering data. Today's mission is to
learn
about what attracts people to
big-name
celebrities.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's market research. Understanding what
the
people want is vital to becoming a
super ultra
mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Without it, it would be
impossible for
me to win... ra...ces...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Did we have training scheduled for
today?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear...  The characteristics of a
mascot are
purity, propriety, and charm.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I apologize. This won't happen again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She continues to apologize profusely, so
I let her
off with a warning.
